indication_area: Epilepsy (seizures of Lennox-Gastaut syndrome, Dravet syndrome, tuberous sclerosis complex)
geography: Worldwide (U.S. Epidiolex plus ex-U.S. Epidyolex as totalled by the issuer)
moa: Cannabinoid (plant-derived cannabidiol); mechanism of anticonvulsant effect not fully characterized

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 210365, Company: JAZZ PHARMS RES, EPIDIOLEX CANNABIDIOL ... 06/25/2018 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity PRIORITY; Orphan

launch_evidence.quote: We launched Epidiolex on November 1, 2018 in the U.S. market

unreported_quarters.2021Q2: Ownership change GW Pharmaceuticals to Jazz Pharmaceuticals; no full-quarter figure is published. Jazz completed the GW acquisition on May 5, 2021; GW filed its last periodic report (10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2021) on 2021-05-03 and a Form 15 on 2021-05-17. Jazz's 2021Q2 release prints Epidiolex/Epidyolex of 109,481 thousand covering only May 5-June 30 ('This includes sales from May 5, 2021, the closing date of the GW Acquisition'), and its pro forma full-quarter figure is unaudited pro forma, not reported net sales, so 2021Q2 is excluded.

search_log: [GW piece] Listed every GW Pharmaceuticals (CIK 0001351288) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions: 123 6-K, 5 20-F, 2 20-F/A, 33 8-K, 7 10-Q, 3 10-K, 1 10-K/A, 1 10-KT (all forms counted). Fetched every 6-K/8-K/10-Q/10-K/10-KT/20-F document filed 2018-07 to 2021-06 (8-K exhibits via each filing's index.json).

[GW piece] GW changed its fiscal year end from September 30 to December 31 in 2018 (10-KT for October 1 - December 31, 2018) and filed 8-K/10-Q/10-K from then on. Its tables print only total 'Product net sales' (Epidiolex plus Sativex); the Epidiolex figure is printed in prose (10-Q/10-K MD&A 'consists of $X million in net sales of Epidiolex and $Y million in net sales of Sativex', and release highlights 'Total net product sales of Epidiolex of $X million'), which is what each row quotes.

[GW piece] 2019Q1-2019Q3: GW's own filings for those quarters print U.S. Epidiolex and ex-U.S. Epidyolex/early-access sales separately (e.g. Q3 2019 10-Q: '$86.1 million in net sales of Epidiolex in the United States, $1.9 million of Epidyolex sales outside of the United States'), never their total; the worldwide total is printed first as the prior-year comparative in the 2020 10-Qs, which the rows use (derivation direct_prior_year_column) rather than summing regions.
[GW piece] 2018Q3 and earlier: Epidiolex was launched in the U.S. on November 1, 2018 (10-KT), so 2018Q4 is the first quarter of sales.

[Jazz piece] Listed every Jazz Pharmaceuticals (CIK 0001232524) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older pages); took every 8-K/8-K/A filed 2020-07 to 2026-11 whose items include 2.02, 9.01 or 7.01 and fetched every non-primary .htm exhibit from each filing's index.json.

[Jazz piece] The product row was read from the first table of each quarterly release whose first cell starts with the brand (the 'Total revenues' table listing product sales, net by product); the current three-month column is the first figure. Unit is read from the table's own '(In thousands)' / '(In millions)' header: thousands through the 2025Q4 release, millions from the 2026Q1 release.
[Jazz piece] Jazz line is 'Epidiolex/Epidyolex' (worldwide). Jazz consolidated GW from May 5, 2021, so 2021Q2 is a stub and excluded; the series resumes with the first full Jazz quarter 2021Q3.
